title: The Advisor filter is a multi-select of the advisors present in the loaded jobs and narrows rows on screen only
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows jobs for at least two different advisors.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Advisor filter in the toolbar and read its options.
2. Select one advisor and watch the rows.
3. Add a second advisor to the selection.
custom_expected:
1. The Advisor filter is a multi-select listing the advisors present in the loaded jobs.
2. Selecting one or more advisors narrows the visible jobs to those advisors instantly, on screen only — no reload and no loading indicator.
3. With two advisors selected, jobs for either advisor are shown.
